proposed_comments.title: Distinguish the two single-key settings routes
proposed_comments.body:
### Distinguish the two single-key settings routes

**Severity:** `low`

The `LoadSingleKeyRemaps` comment groups `singleKeyToSequenceReMap` with the tables routed by the optional `condition` field, but sequence entries are actually read separately from `inProcessSequence`. Please describe the two routes separately so maintainers are not directed to look for sequence selection in `condition`. This is a documentation-only clarification; runtime behavior is unchanged.

```suggestion
    // Parses inProcess into singleKeyReMap / aloneSingleKeyReMap using optional per-entry "condition",
    // and inProcessSequence separately into singleKeyToSequenceReMap. Public so the
```

confidence.rationale: The changed method comment groups sequence routing under condition, while the exact implementation independently reads the sequence array. Adjacent documentation mitigates the confusion but does not make this method comment accurate. The request is limited to documentation.
